output.scope_note: This is a theoretical paper on oxygen-ion conduction in nanocrystalline ZrO2:16% Y, and it gives no numeric ionic conductivity values in the text; the experimental conductivity data appear only in figures (Figs. 4, 6, 7), and the only numbers cited (E0 = 1.23 eV, the two-to-three-orders-of-magnitude enhancement) are an activation energy and a qualitative ratio.
